messages:
raph: deploy-bot blocked the staging->prod promote for redwood/batch:2.9.3 — provenance mismatch between gcr-us mirror and origin. holding the window.

deploy-bot: :warning: publish-guard: provenance CHECK FAILED
attested_manifest=sha256:9f1a2b...
registry_manifest(gcr-us)=sha256:9f2b3c...
build_id=202604011430 cosign=present

sophia: canary traffic was fine, but we only run full attestation in the gating job. looks like mirror normalization changed blob digests during copy.

tim: attach push log excerpt:
```
2026-04-01T14:30:10Z INFO uploader: multipart push complete
2026-04-01T14:30:11Z INFO mirror: copying manifest -> gcr-us
2026-04-01T14:30:12Z WARN mirror: normalized digest (stripped padding)
2026-04-01T14:30:13Z INFO attestor: created attestation (manifest=sha256:9f1a2b...)
2026-04-01T14:30:14Z INFO registry(gcr-us): stored manifest sha256:9f2b3c...
2026-04-01T14:30:14Z ERROR provenance: attested vs registry mismatch
```

uma: options: 1) wait (no), 2) republish the same build with canonical manifest and pin digest, 3) retag as 2.9.3-pin1 and re-attest. prefer 3 to keep original tag intact for audit.

raph: +1 retag as 2.9.3-pin1 in gcr-us and re-attest. QA should run full provenance lint before any rollout. schedule a 10m change window to avoid mirror races.

victor: I'll do the republish. plan: pull canonical blobs from primary, normalize manifest ordering & digest form, push redwood/batch:2.9.3-pin1 to gcr-us with explicit manifest digest, upload cosign attestation, update deploybot canary mapping. queueing manual_republish.

deploy-bot: action queued: manual_republish_request by victor for build 202604011430.

victor: pulled blobs and verified build_id. created canonical manifest and pushed 2.9.3-pin1 -> digest sha256:9f3c4d... attaching attestation using same key.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: republish complete. registry_manifest(gcr-us)=sha256:9f3c4d... attestation attached.

sophia: QA starting full provenance lint + canary smoke on 2.9.3-pin1. Will hold promotion manual until green.

raph: decision: DO NOT promote original 2.9.3 tag. Promote 2.9.3-pin1 to canary after QA. Keep 2.9.3 frozen for 1 hour for audit. Add a note in release-notes: "Artifact republished as 2.9.3-pin1 in US due to mirror normalization; original tag held." Notify support & sales about the short release window.

victor: QA green. requesting gradual rollout at 5% with rollback criteria: +5% error rate or +25% latency p90 sustained for 10m.

deploy-bot: manual rollout requested by victor: route 5% traffic to redwood/batch:2.9.3-pin1.

tim: monitoring at 5% looks clean. will ramp per rollout playbook. follow-up: file ticket to add an early provenance lint to CI pre-mirror copy to catch mirror-normalization issues earlier.

raph: thanks all. logging this thread into the release audit and updating changelog with the republish note. :thumbsup:
